notes.title: December Patch
notes.notes:
Sorry for the long silence! We are working hard on improving functionality and UX and bringing you the new shiny "Argil" in the next several months.
Meanwhile, here's some fixed bugs (annoying "You haven't saved for a while") and a new Symmetrization tool!
Enjoy

notes.title: Version 0.7 is out there!
notes.notes:
Hi all!

the new version of Argil is out there!

Thank you, our community, for the ongoing feedback, both on Steam page and on Discord (don't forget to join Discord here). We listen to our users and try to improve the functionality regularly and fix the bugs as quickly as possible.

We have put into this update:


Brand New Draw brushes. You can now freely draw in the air! and create long windy meshes (perfect for hair, limbs, fingers etc). Two brushes “single draw” and “continuous draw”. Continuous draw adds the drawn object to the previous one (combines them), so that you would have a single entity that you can afterwards manipulate as a one object.
We know that some of you really liked the resolution brush, so we decided to improve it even more. We have increased the speed of resolution brush: around 3 times for the increasing resolution, and 10 times for decreasing resolution
Easier selection and movement of the objects. We have heard that it was sometimes a bit tricky to move the objects around, now it's much easier. More natural way of grabbing them, additional raycast to choose the objects
Undo / Redo can now be called with the menu buttons on the right / left hand, respectively.
Added new sample 3D models (dummy face, man)
Fixed multiple bugs
- Filebrowser is not being stuck
- Fixed the annoying lock of the Auto-Save pop-up
- Remove multiple click
- Remove colliders when undoing or deleting
- Grabbing 3rd view camera


This mid 20th century man wishes you all the best with using Argil
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40168052/2bdb002ea0408b73638a8bc9e8a5e59a9f656eac.png

For now, this is all. In addition, two things we really would love to add are:
- merging several meshes into one,
- increasing the vertex limit beyond 65K vertices. 

Yours,
Team Argil

notes.title: Regular update. ver 0.6.82
notes.notes:
2021/05/21
Regular update. Ver. 0.6.82

 New align function
 Choice and control of the 3rd view camera (with green screen for OBS mixed reality capture mode)
 Undo works on the new objects
 Locking objects
 Slight improvements in UX:
 Using “Undo” button to stop any long function, such as Resolution Brush
 Protect clay from being manipulated when using a menu
 Resetting alignment in the exported OBJ files
 Easier pressing buttons
 Fixed minor bugs

notes.notes:
2021/04/29
Weekly update. Ver 0.6.81 

 Fixed a bug for redo on the new objects
 Moving object(s) with two hands simultaneously
 Improved object selection by grabbing
 Improved undo for working with many objects and imported objects
 Improved UI for Fast Export json files / Load last / Autosave

notes.title: Monday patch. 26 April 2021
notes.notes:
The first patch following user feedback:

- Improved button press (more intuitive)
- Increased number of Undo's (from 10 to 40 on each object, from 25 to 100 on all objects)
- Better navigation of the third view camera
